items.title: Abraham
items.charge: Obeying the Lord's voice; keeping his charge, his commandments, his statutes, and his laws

items.title: Antipas, Smyrna, and Philadelphia
items.charge: Faithful unto death; keeping the word of his patience; not denying his name in the place where Satan's seat is

items.title: Asa in his first years
items.charge: Taking away the strange altars and the high places; commanding Judah to seek the Lord and do the law; crying to the Lord against a million Ethiopians

items.title: Cornelius
items.charge: A devout man, one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway

items.title: David
items.charge: A man after the Lord's own heart; keeping his commandments and following him with all his heart, save only in the matter of Uriah

items.title: Hannah
items.charge: Praying in bitterness of soul, vowing a son to the Lord, and giving him when she had him

items.title: Hiel the Bethelite
items.charge: Rebuilding Jericho under the oath Joshua swore before the Lord

items.title: Israel at the first Passover
items.charge: Doing as the Lord commanded Moses and Aaron: the lamb, the blood on the door, the unleavened bread

items.title: Jehoiada the priest
items.charge: Hiding the king's son six years from Athaliah; making a covenant between the Lord, the king, and the people; doing good in Israel, both toward God and toward his house

items.title: Jehoshaphat's alliances
items.charge: Joining affinity with Ahab; going to Ramoth-gilead with him; joining with Ahaziah to make ships

items.title: Jonadab and the Rechabites
items.charge: Obeying the commandment of Jonadab their father for over two hundred years: no wine, no house, no vineyard, no field

items.title: Josiah
items.charge: A tender heart at the reading of the book; turning to the Lord with all his heart, soul, and might, according to all the law of Moses

items.title: Mattathias
items.charge: Zealous for the law: refusing the king's commandment at Modin, and executing the apostate on the altar as Phinehas did Zambri

items.title: Moses and the uncircumcised son
items.charge: Neglecting the sign of the covenant in his own house

items.title: Noah
items.charge: Doing according to all that God commanded him

items.title: Pharaoh and Abimelech, who took Sarah
items.charge: Taking another man's wife into the king's house

items.title: Phinehas
items.charge: Zealous for his God at Peor; making an atonement for the children of Israel

items.title: Rahab
items.charge: Receiving the spies with peace, and believing that the Lord had given Israel the land

items.title: Saul's house and the Gibeonites
items.charge: Breaking Israel's sworn covenant by slaying the Gibeonites

items.title: The Gibeonites, and Israel's oath
items.charge: Obtaining a covenant by fraud; Israel making it without asking counsel of the Lord

items.title: The sons of Levi at the golden calf
items.charge: Answering, Who is on the Lord's side? and executing the sentence on their own brethren

items.title: Zedekiah
items.charge: Breaking his oath to Nebuchadnezzar; stiffening his neck against the Lord's word by Jeremiah

items.title: Zerubbabel and Joshua the high priest
items.charge: Obeying the voice of the Lord by Haggai; rising up and working on the house of the Lord
